doctrine_validation.tested_condition: Implementation preserves approved doctrine and does not replace it with alternative framing.
doctrine_validation.expected_outcome: Doctrine language and thesis remain intact across implemented pages and metadata.

narrative_validation.tested_condition: Implementation preserves the approved narrative sequence and page intent.
narrative_validation.expected_outcome: Website flow matches Home through Contact in the approved order without narrative drift.

design_parity_validation.tested_condition: Rendered pages match approved designs under plan/impl/design without reinterpretation.
design_parity_validation.expected_outcome: Design fidelity is acceptable across visual hierarchy, spacing, typography, and layout.

responsive_validation.tested_condition: Implementation behaves correctly across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
responsive_validation.expected_outcome: Responsive layouts preserve readability, hierarchy, and usability at approved breakpoints.

accessibility_validation.tested_condition: Implementation meets required accessibility expectations for semantic structure, navigation, and content legibility.
accessibility_validation.expected_outcome: No blocking accessibility regressions remain for release candidate review.

seo_validation.tested_condition: Metadata and page structure support approved SEO discoverability topics without replacing doctrine language.
seo_validation.expected_outcome: Pages are metadata-complete, crawlable, and aligned to approved discoverability topics.

sitemap_validation.tested_condition: Sitemap includes approved pages and supports crawl discovery.
sitemap_validation.expected_outcome: Sitemap accurately represents public website pages in approved narrative scope.

robots_validation.tested_condition: robots.txt supports intended crawl behavior for the public website.
robots_validation.expected_outcome: Robots configuration permits intended search discovery and does not block required pages.

llms_txt_validation.tested_condition: llms.txt exists and supports answer-engine and citation-oriented discoverability.
llms_txt_validation.expected_outcome: LLM-facing guidance is present, accurate, and aligned to approved doctrine and page scope.

structured_data_validation.tested_condition: Structured data is valid and aligned to page meaning without doctrinal drift.
structured_data_validation.expected_outcome: Structured data enhances search understanding and remains faithful to approved intent.

performance_validation.tested_condition: Website rendering and asset behavior meet performance expectations.
performance_validation.expected_outcome: Rendering is fast, bundle hygiene is acceptable, and mobile performance is controlled.

core_web_vitals_validation.tested_condition: Core Web Vitals metrics meet acceptable release thresholds where measurable.
core_web_vitals_validation.expected_outcome: LCP, CLS, and INP indicators support a production-ready experience.

deployment_readiness_validation.tested_condition: All required evidence, configuration, and production checks are complete for human release review.
deployment_readiness_validation.expected_outcome: A release candidate is ready for human acceptance review but not self-approved.
